swap_risks: CAUTION INDUCTOR RETUNING: Typical inductor differs (TPS562201DDCR: 3.3 µH p.13 vs TPS563201DDCR: 2.2 µH p.15); check inductor Isat against peak switch current limit.

CAUTION CURRENT RATING BASIS: TPS562201DDCR specifies 2000 mA (continuous Iout, p.1) vs TPS563201DDCR 3000 mA (continuous Iout, p.1). Verify continuous load current and peak inductor saturation margin (Isat >= Iout + ΔIL/2).
engineering_verdict: TPS562201DDCR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-6) and TPS563201DDCR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-6) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because recommended inductor value differs >20%; current rating or switch-limit basis differs. Power-stage deltas: buck (sync) vs buck (sync), switching frequency 580 kHz (p.5) vs 580 kHz (p.6) (1x ratio), typical inductor 3.3 µH (p.13) vs 2.2 µH (p.15), feedback Vref 0.768 V (p.5) vs 0.768 V (p.6), and package θJA 90.8 vs 92.6 °C/W. Primary bench gotchas to watch: TPS562201DDCR "Pin-Identical 2 A Sibling of TPS563201DDCR — Verify Current Limit & Inductor Sizing" (p.5) and TPS563201DDCR "17 V Max Input (19 V Abs Max) Fails on 24 V Buses Built for Pin-Identical TPS54302DDCR" (p.4). BOM decision: Choose TPS562201DDCR when matching your existing Texas Instruments SOT-23-6 (DDC) qualification and -40..125 °C grade; choose TPS563201DDCR when higher load current capacity (3000 mA) is required. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
